case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

We are delighted to submit our proposal for your consideration. We offer a price of €16.00 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

thank you for your reply and for moving towards us. We hold a competing offer at EUR 14.70 per unit (offer:DEMO-J1-3). We can improve our proposal to EUR 14.48 per unit, payment 45 days net, a lead time of 35 days, Incoterm EXW. Could you meet us there?

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your improved offer and for sharing the competitive situation with us. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed the competing offer you mentioned, but it does not impact our calculation. Nevertheless, we are pleased to offer a further reduction to EUR 15.60 per unit to move closer to an agreement.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are happy to propose a price of €15.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a Lieferzeit 35 days, and delivery EXW.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to building a strong partnership with you.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:

thank you for your offer. We are taking it through our internal approval and will confirm shortly. There are no further changes from our side.

Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
messages.body:
Dear partner,

Thank you for the update and for taking our offer of EUR 15.60 per unit through your internal approval process. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stands at a price of €15.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We stand ready to proceed as soon as you have the final confirmation. As a growing partner, we look forward to a successful and long-term cooperation.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
